items.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
items.summary: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

items.title: Bitcoin’s biggest bet is now a drop below $60,000, not a rally above $100,000
items.summary: The $60,000 put has replaced the $100,000 call as bitcoin’s biggest options bet on Deribit, with $900 million in open interest after the recent slide.

items.title: Changing of Lagarde: How the candidates to be next ECB president view bitcoin, stablecoins and CBDCs
items.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down from her post in February 2027, and none of the primary candidates to succeed her are great fans of crypto.

items.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
items.summary: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

items.title: Britain could turn wasted Scottish wind power into bitcoin to cut its $1.3 billion grid bill
items.summary: Britain could use bitcoin mining to absorb surplus Scottish wind power and reduce payments to wind farms to halt generation, according to a Bitcoin Policy…

items.title: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility
items.summary: Both bitcoin and ether are trading in price ranges where market makers and dealers may add to market volatility.

items.title: Satoshi-era wallet served in a $260 billion lawsuit moves 75 BTC it held since 2011
items.summary: The roughly $5 million transfer also spent the tiny payment used to deliver a court notice to the address in May.

items.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
items.summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec.
